entries.expectedBasis: Variant: CRJ100 / CRJ100ER (CF34-3A1), Wikipedia CRJ100/200 table (one combined table: values assigned to the CRJ100 by column order, which the page does not state explicitly). Range: ER 1,305 nmi, below the 1,500 nmi anchor -> 0.0 (LR 1,650 nmi would be 0.0 too). Capacity: 50 seats -> under 60 -> 0.0. Efficiency: no fuel burn figure -> null. Speed: normal cruise Mach 0.74 -> 1 + (0.74-0.70)/(0.78-0.70) = 1.5. Runway: 5,800 ft (ER) at MTOW, SL, ISA -> 5 - 300/1,500 = 4.8 -> 5.0 (LR 6,290 ft would be 4.5). Comfort: all three reviews are of the CRJ200, whose fuselage and 50-seat cabin are identical to the CRJ100's (FlyRadius: only the engine differs); all three call the cabin cramped -> criticised = 1. This applies a sibling's cabin reviews to the CRJ100, flagged here; if that is unacceptable set comfort null. Reviews dated: the AirlineReporter piece's date is not shown on the page (comments from Oct 2015), so null. Comfort null: reviews cover the CRJ200 cabin.
